note: The house studios. For each lot, each rival secretly flips a ceiling from the list that matches how many of its favourite traits the star has (index 0 = none, 1 = one, 2 = two, 3 = three). Vault legends add legendBonus, or use the legend list if the studio has one. They raise $1M at a time up to that ceiling, never break the reserve rule, and never know the genre. pace: a rival never bids more than pace × (budget left ÷ empty slots), so it keeps money for later lots. Neck and neck: a rival never gets more than two stars ahead of the slowest human (RULES.rivalLead).
